verdict.rationale: Capacities ships a built-in AI assistant with several delegable tasks: AI Chats (ask questions with note/block context), AI Property Auto-Fill (auto-populate object properties), and AI Image Analysis (OCR, tagging, categorization) — all opt-in per docs-16/44. However, these are narrow, single-purpose AI actions rather than a general-purpose agent capable of open-ended task delegation or multi-step autonomous action within the app. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-step/autonomous task execution, ability to delegate broader workflows (not just chat/autofill/image analysis), and independent/hands-on validation of the AI assistant's real-world reliability.
